source: EQUYSIS, Modbus map of the ULTRA TT user guide (Medidor ultrasonico ULTRA TT)

sources.title: Mapa Modbus, Guia de usuario ULTRA TT

notes: EQUYSIS Ultra-TT ultrasonic flow meter. Addresses come from the read and write examples of the document (the register table of the PDF is garbled, so the examples decide where they differ).

Each measurement uses three registers: a 32-bit value (high word first) and one word with the unit code in its high byte and the number of decimal digits in its low byte. Example: 0x075BCD15 with unit 0x2C and 1 digit is 12345678.9 m3.
Unit codes: 0x29 L, 0x2C m3, 0x32 L/h, 0x35 m3/h, 0x40 degrees C, 0x41 K, 0x50 h, 0x51 d.

Reads use function 03 (several registers per request); writes use function 06 or 16. Error responses use codes 0x8001 (date error), 0x8002 (address error) and 0x8030 (address plus count too long, or zero).
The document does not say whether the 32-bit values are signed, and gives no factory serial settings other than the example slave address 1. Not tested on a device.

registers.name: Device status
registers.description: Bit 7: factory flag set; bit 6: seals set; bit 5: sensor error; bit 2: power low

registers.name: Slave address
registers.description: Modbus address, 1 to 247 (the address in the frame changes after a write)

registers.name: Communication parameters
registers.description: Bits 2-0 baud rate (000: 2400, 001: 300, 010: 600, 011: 1200, 100: 2400, 101: 4800, 110: 9600), bit 3 stop bits (0: one, 1: two), bits 5-4 parity (00 even, 01 none, 10 even, 11 odd), bits 7-6 protocol (01: Modbus)

registers.name: Date and time
registers.description: Written with function 16 as 12 ASCII digits: month, day, year, hour, minute, second (two digits each)
